investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia and AI chip sector will re-accelerate as geopolitical risk premiums flatten and Jensen Huang leadership signals U.S. government backing removes national security overhang.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO, stock jumped 27-35%; Trump told CNBC he gave Nvidia board assurance Huang is not a national security threat
Hacker News: Jensen Huang reinstatement scored 1302 points (highest discussion), indicating institutional attention
CoinDesk: Nasdaq soared 6% on Huang return; AI narratives remain critical to tech upside
investment_theses.counter_view: Huang reinstatement may already be priced in; ongoing intelligence probe could resurface; Taiwan-U.S. geopolitical risk remains unresolved and could trigger sudden reversals.
investment_theses.expression: Long NVDA calls (6-month ATM or 10% OTM strike); alternatively, long QQQ or XLK to capture broadened chip/tech sector momentum
